description: The reads of inputs/sorted-counts-above-leaves, which the freeze hazard left with a sorted map and a sorted set, each with its clone: a header and a root that agree (41 for the map, 42 for the set), over leaves that hold fewer than the root counts for them: the copy wrote first, which copied its root and its first leaf, and then the original removed 10 keys in place in the leaves they still share. It's pinned as the original reads it, a file with no byte damaged: count, every position from two before the start to one past the end, every key by key and by rank, the walk from the start in full, and on each clone an iterator from every position and from every key, by its first entry, how many it gives, and the null. And an iterator from each position whose read raises InvalidBTreeNode raises it too, at the iterator: on the map clone from the positions -27, -26, -19, -18, -11, -10, -2, -1, 14, 15, 22, 23, 30, 31, 39, 40; and on the set clone from the positions -27, -26, -19, -18, -11, -10, -2, -1, 15, 16, 23, 24, 31, 32, 40, 41. The original checks the leaf an iterator starts in since 274418f, as the port does, and these were left out until then, as the port answered them otherwise.
